This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

An angel whose halo was damaged, meaning they can't return to heaven until it's healed.  Stunk and Zel promised to take care of them until then, but in the meantime, they're forced to be a member of the Interspecies Reviewers.

After taking the gender-swap potion, they're called "Clitorim"

~!He's referred to as "Stunkette" when he takes a female shape.!~

As an elf, he's over 200 years old. He's one of the founding members of the Interspecies Reviewers.
~!In his female form, he's called "Zellie"!~

She's a snide mage with a lot of power. Due to the fact that she runs a succu-joint solely on clones of herself she's also probably pretty full of herself. Besides that she's sweet yet careful for the people around her that she works with.
